description: Deribit BTC DVOL (implied volatility index) history at 1-hour and 1-minute(7d) resolution -- a volatility-regime reference series, not itself a price feed.
source: Deribit public REST, no auth: public/get_volatility_index_data (currency=BTC), paged backwards via the response's `continuation` cursor -- see scripts/fetch_deribit.py. deribit_dvol_1h.csv uses resolution=3600 (paged back as far as the API allows, target >=180 days); deribit_dvol_1m_7d.csv uses resolution=60 for the last 7 days only.
retention: appended forward, merged with existing history on every fetch run (never truncated).
known_defects: no volume column -- DVOL is an index level, not a traded instrument, so zero_volume/extreme_return-style checks that assume a tradable price series don't directly apply
deribit_dvol_1m_7d.csv is a rolling 7-day window re-fetched on every run, not an accumulating history -- it does not extend past 7 days even though the file is appended-and-merged like the others
